text: {"lessons":["I should not let a desire to lock in gains or avoid realizing losses determine trades; each position needs a fresh, forward-looking assessment.","Doing nothing for many periods and then buying every stock at once is not a plan; I should decide deliberately how much cash to invest and when.","Because past price moves do not predict future prices, I should avoid treating recent declines or rebounds as signals and focus instead on risk and portfolio balance."]}
